tooltip.modernitemducts.duct.dense: Heavy: destinations through it are tried last.
tooltip.modernitemducts.duct.vacuum: Light: destinations through it are tried first.
tooltip.modernitemducts.wrench: Click a duct side to block/unblock it, an attachment to remove it. Sneak-click to pick up the duct.
tooltip.modernitemducts.servo: Pulls items from the inventory it faces into the duct network.
tooltip.modernitemducts.retriever: Fetches items from other inventories on the network into the one it faces.
tooltip.modernitemducts.filter: Limits which items the network may put into the inventory it faces.
tooltip.modernitemducts.stats: Up to %s items every %s s, speed %s
gui.modernitemducts.flag.exclude.on: Deny list: matching items are blocked
gui.modernitemducts.flag.exclude.off: Allow list: only matching items pass
gui.modernitemducts.flag.ignore_tags.off: Items sharing any tag also match
gui.modernitemducts.flag.ignore_mod.on: The owning mod is not compared
gui.modernitemducts.flag.ignore_mod.off: Any item from the same mod also matches
gui.modernitemducts.oversend.on: Counts items already on their way (no over-filling)
gui.modernitemducts.oversend.off: Ignores items already on their way
gui.modernitemducts.max_stock: Keep at most this many of each item in the target (∞ = no limit)
gui.modernitemducts.info.servo: Item Servo: pulls items out of the inventory it faces and sends them into the ducts. The grid filters what it pulls.
gui.modernitemducts.info.retriever: Item Retriever: fetches items matching its grid from other inventories on the network.
gui.modernitemducts.info.filter: Item Filter: only items passing the grid may be delivered into the inventory it faces.
gui.modernitemducts.info.shift: +/-: click = 1, Shift+left = 16, Shift+right = 4. Right-click cycles buttons backwards.
